flags.message: Provisioned documents include only the Soto Palmer respondents' brief in opposition. The docket carries a second respondent brief the same day ('Brief of respondent Washington filed', Jun 02 2026) in which the State asks the Court to GVR in light of Louisiana v. Callais, and a Jun 10 reply. Neither was provisioned; I retrieved both from supremecourt.gov. The un-provisioned State brief is the single most decisive input for this cell, so a predictor working from the provisioned set alone would anchor far lower.

Public information predating the snapshot was decisive: the Court's May 11 and May 18, 2026 GVRs in light of Callais and the State's June 2 GVR request. Forward-mode signal, not leakage. No disposition of this petition surfaced; the docket shows no entry after 2026-06-17.

The frozen distribution_count of 2 reads as one relist under the band derivation, but the docket's second distribution (Jun 17, for the 9/28 conference) followed a call for a response after the first distribution and is a redistribution after briefing, not a relist. The band is used as frozen; noting so a reader of the relist-increment claim knows the state it is forecast from.
